notes.title: Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
Fixed a handful of bugs that resulted from the engine upgrade. Thank you for your reports!


 Steam achievements will sync up once you start a new game.
 You can now purchase the audio book CD from Brains & Puzzles.
 Gallery thumbnails align properly.
 Omake text is in the correct position.


Another reminder to anyone on Windows XP, please save a copy of this somewhere. Support for Windows XP will be dropping very soon.

notes.title: Engine Update
notes.notes:
It's been a couple years since Backstage Pass was last uploaded, so I've just re-uploaded it with the most recent engine.

Mac Users:
Am currently looking into Catalina support. Stay tuned!

Windows Users:
Will not be able to support XP much longer. I recommend saving a copy of this version somewhere if you need it to run on XP.
